Shell(cat > "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/vmtest2.mjs" <<'EOF' import vm from "node:vm"; function tryCase(label, opts, code) { try { const ctx = vm.createContext({}, opts); const r = vm.runInContext(code, ctx); console.log(label, "-> OK:", JSON.stringify(r)); } catch (e) { console.log(label, "-> FAIL:", e.message); } } const webpackEval = 'var __webpack_require__ = { r: () => 1 }; eval("__webpack_require__.r({})");'; tryCase("with name + strings:true", { name: "Edge Runtime", codeGeneration: { strings: true, wasm: true } }, webpackEval); tryCase("no name + strings:true", { codeGeneration: { strings: true, wasm: true } }, webpackEval); tryCase("no options", {}, webpackEval); tryCase("strings:false", { codeGeneration: { strings: false, wasm: true } }, webpackEval); EOF node "$COMMANDCODE_SCRATCHPAD/vmtest2.mjs")
